license: CC-BY, as explicitly stated by authors in ICWSM 2025 paper
target: source campaign vs non-campaign annotation; not bot identity, truth or malicious intent
selection: all JSON graphs in released LEN-small tar; no selection by model result
split: stratified by source class, rank by sha256(signal-desk-len-small-v1|source-relative-name), 60/20/remainder percent train/calibration/test; test labels only used for final fixed evaluation
features: public interaction topology only; no titles, text, bios, account labels, political subtype or original identifiers
preprocessing: training-only feature means/scales; no per-edge split; all records from each trend stay together
model: L2 logistic regression, fixed lr=.05, 3000 iterations, lambda=.1; class-weighted training; scores not calibrated probabilities
comparison: majority-class training baseline and size-only logistic baseline on identical split
threshold: select on calibration only: maximize recall subject to empirical FPR<=.10; if no positive thresholds qualify, abstain rather than tune on test
uncertainty: Wilson 95% descriptive intervals at graph-level; small corpus and collection/graph-size biases; actor overlap across trends unknown
privacy: do not persist raw graph text/account fields or send any records to external models; local stream parsing, retain only source hashes and numeric topology; publish aggregate metrics only
runtime: candidate separate from v2 post-coaction lab; no claim to improve prior v1 synthetic intent metrics
